# Packages

```{r}
library(corrplot)
library(GGally)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(phyloseq)
library(phyloseqCompanion)
library(viridis)
library(beepr)
library(ggtext)
library(flextable)
library(usdm)
library(caret)
```

# Phyloseq

Analysis will be performed in envrionmental variables from:

- Reefs and lakes combined
- Reefs only
- Lakes only

```{r}
reefs_lakes  <- readRDS("data/bcms_filtered_raja2023.rds")
reefs        <- readRDS("data/bcms_filtered_reefs_raja2023.rds")
lakes        <- readRDS("data/bcms_filtered_lakes_raja2023.rds")
```

# Environmental matrixes

The environmental parameters were embedded in the physoseq object. So we can extract it from there and manipulate it as a dataframe. 


Select and standardize the environmental variables for analysis

```{r environmental scale}

env_gllvm_reeflake <- sample.data.frame(reefs_lakes@sam_data) %>% 
  filter_at(vars(site), all_vars(!is.na(.)))

env_gllvm_reef <- sample.data.frame(reefs@sam_data) %>% 
  filter_at(vars(site), all_vars(!is.na(.)))

env_gllvm_lake <- sample.data.frame(lakes@sam_data) %>% 
  filter_at(vars(site), all_vars(!is.na(.)))

#Standarize numerical environmental data

env_gllvm_reeflake.scaled <- env_gllvm_reeflake %>% 
  select(connection,temperature,salinity,chla, mean.PO4, DIN) %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

env_gllvm_reef.scaled <- env_gllvm_reef %>% 
  select(temperature,salinity,chla, mean.PO4, DIN) %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

env_gllvm_lake.scaled <- env_gllvm_lake %>% 
  select(temperature,salinity,chla, mean.PO4, DIN) %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  as.data.frame()
```

# Correlation tests

Correlation test

```{r correlation and significance test}
#Reefs + Lakes
cor_matrix_reeflake <- cor(env_gllvm_reeflake.scaled, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cor_test_reeflake <- cor.mtest(env_gllvm_reeflake.scaled, conf.level = 0.95)

#Reefs
cor_matrix_reef <- cor(env_gllvm_reef.scaled, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cor_test_reef <- cor.mtest(env_gllvm_reef.scaled, conf.level = 0.95)

#Lakes
cor_matrix_lake <- cor(env_gllvm_lake.scaled, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cor_test_lake <- cor.mtest(env_gllvm_lake.scaled, conf.level = 0.95)

```

# Correlation Plot 

Setting correlation plot color palette
```{r corr palette}
color_cor <-c("#7F3B08",
              "#B75B04",
              "#E68D25",
              "#FDC57E",
              "#FEEDD6",
              "#E9EAF3",
              "#BEBADA",
              "#8B7FB4",
              "#582F8C",
              "#3B1559")

```

## Reefs + Lakes

```{r}
svg("figures/correlations/correlation_env_reefs&lakes.svg", #assign directory
    width = 11,
    height = 11)

corrplot(cor_matrix_reeflake,
         method = "circle",                 # Circle style
         type = "lower",                    # Only upper triangle
         order = "alphabet",                     # Order of variables
         p.mat = cor_test_reeflake$p,                # Add significance
         sig.level = 0.05,                  # Show only significant correlations
         insig = "p-value",                   # Leave blank if not significant
         col = colorRampPalette(color_cor)(10),  # Color palette
         tl.col = "black",                  # Axis text color
         tl.srt = 45,                       # Rotate labels
         tl.cex = 0.9,                      # Axis label size
         cl.pos = "b",                      # Color legend at bottom
         cl.ratio = 0.2,                    # Color legend size
         addgrid.col = "grey",            
         mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1),               # Plot margins
         diag = FALSE)
dev.off()
```

Variable filtering after correlation tests

```{r}
# Set and remove cutoff
remove_idx <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix_reeflake, cutoff = 0.75)

# Get variable names to remove
vars_to_remove <- colnames(env_gllvm_reeflake.scaled)[remove_idx]
print(vars_to_remove)

# Filter the dataframe / final environmental matrix
env_gllvm_reeflake.final <- env_gllvm_reeflake.scaled[, -remove_idx]

# View remaining variables
cat("\n✅ Variables kept for modeling:\n")
print(colnames(env_gllvm_reeflake.final))

#Check VIF
vifstep(env_gllvm_reeflake.final, th = 5)  #No collinearity on remaining variables

write.csv(env_gllvm_reeflake.final, file = "data/environmental_scaled_filtered_reefs&lakes.csv")
```

Variables kept for modeling are `r env_gllvm_reeflake.final`/ temperature, salinity, chla, mean.PO4, DIN

## Reefs 

```{r}
svg("figures/correlations/correlation_env_reefs.svg", #assign directory
    width = 11,
    height = 11)

corrplot(cor_matrix_reef,
         method = "circle",                 # Circle style
         type = "lower",                    # Only upper triangle
         order = "alphabet",                     # Order of variables
         p.mat = cor_test_reef$p,                # Add significance
         sig.level = 0.05,                  # Show only significant correlations
         insig = "p-value",                   # Leave blank if not significant
         col = colorRampPalette(color_cor)(10),  # Color palette
         tl.col = "black",                  # Axis text color
         tl.srt = 45,                       # Rotate labels
         tl.cex = 0.9,                      # Axis label size
         cl.pos = "b",                      # Color legend at bottom
         cl.ratio = 0.2,                    # Color legend size
         addgrid.col = "grey",            
         mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1),               # Plot margins
         diag = FALSE)
dev.off()
```

Variable filtering after correlation tests

```{r}
remove_idx <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix_reef, cutoff = 0.75)

# Get variable names to remove
vars_to_remove <- colnames(env_gllvm_reef.scaled)[remove_idx]
print(vars_to_remove)

# Keep the remaining variables
if (length(remove_idx) > 0) {
  env_gllvm_reef.final <- env_gllvm_reef.scaled[, -remove_idx, drop = FALSE]
} else {
  env_gllvm_reef.final <- env_gllvm_reef.scaled
}

cat("\n✅ Variables kept for modeling:\n")
print(colnames(env_gllvm_reef.final))

# Run VIF
if (ncol(env_gllvm_reef.final) > 1) {
  vifstep(env_gllvm_reef.final, th = 5)
} else {
  message("⚠️ Not enough variables left for VIF check.")
}

# Salinity has VIF >5 so it will be removed 
env_gllvm_reef.final <- env_gllvm_reef.final %>% 
  select(-salinity)

write.csv(env_gllvm_reef.final, file = "data/environmental_scaled_filtered_reefs.csv")
```

Variables kept for modeling are `r env_gllvm_reef.final`/ temperature, chla, PO4, DIN

Variable filtering after correlation tests

```{r}
remove_idx <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix_lake, cutoff = 0.75)

# Get variable names to remove
vars_to_remove <- colnames(env_gllvm_lake.scaled)[remove_idx]
print(vars_to_remove)

# Keep the remaining variables
if (length(remove_idx) > 0) {

```

Variables kept for modeling are `r env_gllvm_lake.final`/ salinity, temperature, chla, PO4, DIN

vifstep flagged PO4 as having multicollinearity problems. We decided to retain them since the correlations between the other variables was not higher than 0.6. But we keep this in mind for further models interpretations. 

# Final dfs

Final environmental files are: 

Reefs + Lakes:   "data/environmental_scaled_filtered_reefs&lakes.csv"
Reefs            "data/environmental_scaled_filtered_reefs.csv"
Lakes:           "data/environmental_scaled_filtered_lakes.csv"

# Summary tables

Mean, median, and average of nutrients per habitat type

```{r}
summary_reefs <- env_gllvm_reef %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(temperature, mean.PO4, DIN, mean.NO3, mean.NO2, salinity),  # variables to summarise
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site_type, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
summary_reefs

summary_lakes <- env_gllvm_lake %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(temperature, mean.PO4, DIN, mean.NO3, mean.NO2, salinity),  # variables to summarise
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site_type, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
summary_lakes

summary_all <- bind_rows(summary_reefs, summary_lakes)
summary_all

```

# Gradient of nutrients

```{r}
summary_site <- env_gllvm_reeflake %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(temperature, mean.PO4, DIN, mean.NO3, mean.NO2, mean.NH4, salinity),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site_type, site, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )  %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable, 
    values_from = c(mean, min, max)
  )
View(summary_site)

summary_site_reef <- env_gllvm_reef %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(temperature, mean.PO4, DIN, mean.NO3, mean.NO2, mean.NH4, salinity),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site_type, site, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )  %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable, 
    values_from = c(mean, min, max))
View(summary_site_reef)

summary_site_lake <- env_gllvm_lake %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(temperature, mean.PO4, DIN, mean.NO3, mean.NO2, mean.NH4, salinity),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site_type, site, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )  %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable, 
    values_from = c(mean, min, max))
View(summary_site_lake)
```
